title: The Relation Between Bank Resolutions and Information Environment: Evidence from the Auctions for Failed Bank

scopes.description: Complete author-documented workflow. The supplied variant is the online appendix with supplemental empirical tables and definitions, but contains no runnable source, full workflow, or analysis data.

requirements.description: The appendix reports supplemental analyses using bank-level information, including FDIC closure/P&A resolution outcomes, SEC status, audit level from the last March Call Report before closure, bank financial and loan measures at 2007Q4, asset growth for 2005Q1–2007Q4, and FHFA house-price changes for 2007Q4–2009Q4; OA.3 adds further controls. The appendix does not provide analysis files or enough information to identify the complete input products, sample/crosswalk, stored fields, or construction for the full paper workflow.

issues.description: The supplied inventory contains only the online appendix PDF. There are no executable programs, README/data guide, entry points, complete analysis data, or producer-consumer instructions. The appendix is supplemental and does not specify the full paper workflow or complete input route, leaving dependency closure unresolved.

evidence.description: The document identifies itself as an online appendix containing descriptive statistics and additional tests untabulated in the paper.
evidence.quote: This document contains descriptive statistics and additional empirical tests that are untabulated in the paper.

evidence.description: The appendix says audit levels are taken from bank Call Reports and describes March reporting before closure.
evidence.quote: I make use of information on audit levels taken from the Call Reports of the banking institutions.

evidence.description: OA.1 defines the failed-bank indicator and bank-level measures for 2007Q4, including balance-sheet ratios and FHFA housing-price changes through 2009Q4.

actions.description: Obtain the executable research package and complete analysis-input specification before assessing a full reproduction route.
steps: Request or locate the complete author-provided source package, README/data guide, entry points, and any supporting programs or author-prepared analysis files.

Ask the authors to identify the actual files/products and stored fields, identifiers/crosswalks, sample coverage, construction, and acquisition/preparation route used for the main analysis and appendix tests; use the documented Call Report, FDIC/P&A, FHFA, and other inputs only as specified by the supplied workflow.
Once supplied, trace the complete producer-consumer order and assess the supplied inputs and prescribed software; do not independently reconstruct the historical study data.
validation: Confirm that all required stages and their output producers are documented and ordered from the actual programs, with unresolved handoffs retained as issues.
Verify candidate data fields, identifiers, construction, and time coverage against the author specification before recording any route as compatible.

review_notes: This is a document-only release. It supplies supplemental model and variable descriptions and reported tables, not analysis data or code; no analysis-only execution scope is supported.
